Hi Stephanie —

I'm leading a short vendor evaluation for a cloud inference report at Omdia. Acme has agreed to be a potential reference for Redwood and I wanted to check whether your team is available to coordinate a 25–30 minute reference call next week. The analyst panel would like to understand production performance, deployment model (dedicated vs hosted), and cost/latency tradeoffs you discussed with the customer.

Would appreciate if you can:
- Confirm a Redwood point of contact for the call
- Share any consent form or reference rules we should route to the customer
- Propose two 30-minute windows (US Eastern preferred)

I've attached a short list of suggested questions (omdia_questionnaire_v1.pdf). Happy to adapt.

Thanks —
